metadata.title: Practical Prosperity: Creative & Community Standards
metadata.notes: High-utility certifications for creative, social, and environmental prosperity.

nodes.title: Permaculture Design Certificate (PDC)
nodes.description: The global standard for regenerative design. Ethics, principles, and practical application of permaculture in landscape and community. Linked to Regenerative Agriculture.

nodes.title: Certified Peer Support Specialist
nodes.description: Using lived experience to support others in recovery or mental health challenges. Advocacy, mentoring, and support groups. Linked to Community Care.

nodes.title: Professional Grant Writing Certificate
nodes.description: Identifying funding sources, developing proposals, and managing grant budgets. Mapping sovereign governance and mutual credit to institutional fundraising.

nodes.title: Adobe Certified Professional: Visual Design
nodes.description: Mastery of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Creating professional graphics, layouts, and visual assets. Linked to Visual Mesh-Weaving.

nodes.title: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
nodes.description: Foundations of user experience (UX) design. Empathizing with users, defining pain points, ideating solutions, and creating prototypes. Linked to Frontend Engineering.

edges.rationale: Sovereign regenerative stewardship is the practical fulfillment of the PDC design curriculum.
Community vitality and homeostasis training provide the empathy baseline for peer support roles.
Collective decision-making and project scoping are the core skills of professional grant writing.
